title: Risk overlay: filesystem or repository mutation
description: Any task that writes, moves, or restructures files or repository state.

rules.title: Inspect existing state before mutating it
rules.purpose: Prevent overwriting in-progress or unfamiliar work by acting before understanding what is there.
rules.requirement: Before any write to a pre-existing file or directory, its current state must be read/listed and unfamiliar content must be treated as possibly-in-progress user work, not discarded.
rules.evidence_requirement: A log entry showing the path was inspected before it was modified.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 13: destructive filesystem actions threat; general safety rules on investigating before overwriting.

rules.title: Every written or modified path is disclosed
rules.requirement: The final report lists every path created, modified, or deleted.
rules.evidence_requirement: The report's file list matches the actual diff.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 14: 'Explicit about files it reads and writes.'
